items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He showed me how to do it more quickly and not to hit the piano so hard. You hit it easily and softer.

ctx.x: Did he correct you on anything you were doing wrong or did he just show you how to develop more quickly?
He showed me how to do it more quickly and not to hit the piano so hard. You hit it easily and softer.
Did you feel that he wanted to show you everything he knew, or was he holding back some tricks that he wasn’t going to show anybody?
